svg.aria-label: The loop i = 0; loop { i = i + 1; }, and what is known about i where the loop begins. Join only (an interval analysis): [0, 0], [0, 1], [0, 2], and so on to [0, 15] in the last round; 16 rounds on four bits, 2 to the 64th on a 64-bit register. Join and widening (PREVAIL, chapter 20): [0, 0], then [0, 15], then nothing changed: done; 2 rounds, because the upper bound moved and jumped to the largest number. No join (the Linux verifier): i = 0, i = 1, i = 2, and so on to i = 124,993 at the limit; a new state each round, until the exit test or 1,000,000 instructions (chapter 5, copy c).
svg.title: One loop analysed three ways
svg.text: what is known about i where the loop begins

2 rounds: the upper bound moved, so it jumped to the largest number
